In the linear model with messages and age as predictors, the estimated effect of the Neighbors message is **0.081**. This is the Neighbors coefficient, measured against the Control group. Age is calculated as 2006 minus year of birth.

Because age enters the model additively, with no interaction, this effect is the same at every age, including 25. Adding a message-by-age interaction would give about 0.066 at age 25. I used the additive model because you asked for message and age as predictors.
